entities.summary: Zhang Ziyu is a Chinese basketball player playing for the Shandong Six Stars. She is known for her height of 220 cm. She was named the most valuable player of the 2024 FIBA Under-18 Women's Asia Cup. At 7'3, she is taller than Rumeysa Gelgi, the Guinness World Records verified tallest living woman.
